findings.summary: Current Manual controls add availability and Auto-running disable fences that are absent from the recovered 0.3.17 Manual renderer.
observed: idle-unavailable: original Start Scan enabled; current disabled because online=false
backend-unavailable-with-server: original Clear Map Data enabled; current disabled because backendAvailable=false
auto-running-idle: original speed/Start/Clear enabled; current disables all three while autoRunning=true
backend-unavailable-reading: original Stop enabled; current disables Stop because backendAvailable=false
findings.visualImpact: The required EN/light idle-unavailable browser pair has identical rectangles but current Start Scan computes opacity 0.45 and cursor not-allowed versus original opacity 1 and cursor pointer; this is the only sampled screenshot-byte difference.
findings.proposedCorrectionScope: Do not remove these fences in this evidence task. Project lead should decide whether provider/Auto safety adaptations intentionally override exact 0.3.17 Manual presentation before any bounded correction.

findings.summary: Current disables the sole selected Manual scan type; recovered 0.3.17 keeps all eight scan-type checkboxes enabled.
findings.observed: With selectedTypes=['city'], original Player City checked=true disabled=false; current checked=true disabled=true. The other seven inputs match.
findings.visualImpact: No rectangle difference was observed; the checkbox itself is visually hidden by the recovered compact-chip CSS. The disabled state changes interaction semantics.
findings.proposedCorrectionScope: A separate reviewed correction may restore the original enabled state for the last selected Manual type. Interaction/start semantics should be checked in that task before changing production.
findings.followupEvidence: selection-counter-evidence.json records actual inert callbacks: original [] versus current [city]. Both the Manual checkbox predicate and mapBackend.js updateSelectedTypes must be considered in a correction; preserve separate Auto last-type protection and start payload normalization until source-contract verification.

findings.summary: Current adds type='button' to Start, Stop and Clear; the recovered 0.3.17 buttons omit the type attribute.
findings.observed: Original rendered button type is absent; current renders type='button' for all three Manual actions.
findings.visualImpact: No sampled geometry or computed-style difference is attributable to the type attribute; the three non-fence browser pairs remain byte-identical.
findings.proposedCorrectionScope: No visual correction is justified by this packet. Preserve unless a later strict-DOM parity task explicitly chooses to remove the explicit button type.

findings.summary: Recovered 0.3.17 emits class='' on enabled scan-type labels and direct text after the input; current omits the empty class attribute and wraps label text in a span.
findings.observed: Every original enabled chip has class='' and child element sequence [INPUT] plus a direct text node; current has no class attribute and child elements [INPUT, SPAN].
findings.visualImpact: No sampled geometry/style difference; the recovered CSS styles the label and input state rather than requiring the extra span.
findings.proposedCorrectionScope: If strict DOM parity is requested, remove the wrapper and reproduce the original label class expression in a separate bounded production task. No production edit is authorized here.

findings.summary: Current map-panel adds data-bridge-mode='native'; the recovered 0.3.17 root has only class='panel map-panel'.
findings.observed: The attribute is current-only production host metadata.
findings.visualImpact: No scoped recovered CSS or current styles.css rule targets this attribute; no sampled geometry/style difference.
findings.proposedCorrectionScope: Keep as a current host adaptation; it is retained in raw comparisons and not normalized away.

proofLimits: Offline source-rendered comparison; no protected original runtime pixel acceptance.
Original/current hook renderers run with a fixed clock and inert backend/native producers; no start/stop/clear handler is invoked.
Current exact-recovered EN/JA catalogs are injected into both renderers so translation inputs are identical.
Browser documents contain only the scoped map-panel under body; the wider app shell/navigation is excluded.
No Last War process, protected service or native scan action is exercised.
The error case exercises scanState.lastError rendered with role=status. Local action scanError with role=alert is not exercised in this packet; wider scan-error parity is not claimed.
leadDisposition: Accept comparison evidence only. MMV-BEHAVIOR-001 remains an unresolved source/local UI defect. Preserve provider availability fences; Auto-running fence equivalence remains a separately recorded design/proof question. Other DOM/metadata differences have no measured visual effect in sampled cases.
